source.citation: Singh M, Chandy DD, Bharani T, et al. Clinical outcomes and cortical reserve in adrenal histoplasmosis-A retrospective follow-up study of 40 patients. Clin Endocrinol (Oxf). 2019;90(4):534-541. PMID 30656706.

sourceFindings.adrenalHistoplasmosisDefinition: bilateral adrenal enlargement on CT plus Histoplasma by histology and/or culture of biopsied adrenal tissue
sourceFindings.persistenceAfterTherapy: no patient with primary adrenal insufficiency became eucortisolemic on one-year retesting after antifungal therapy
sourceFindings.incidentDuringFollowUp: 2 of 8 patients with normal cortisol at diagnosis developed adrenal insufficiency during follow-up
